# Toolkit by thechelsuk

> A digital garden of small browser tools, templates and notes at {{ "/" | absolute_url }}, made by thechelsuk for their own work and shared for anyone to use. Tools run in the browser; nothing typed into them is uploaded unless the tool says it uses an outside service.

Key facts:

- Free to use, no account or sign-up
- Made in the UK by thechelsuk ({{ site.owner.url }})
- UK-specific calculators cover redundancy pay, FIRE retirement, ISA bridging and drawdown runway
- Every library, gem, action and outside service is listed in the SBOM at {{ "/sbom" | absolute_url }}
